notes: Plain-text 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 1998. The index (lines 38 to 56) is not labeled; the body Part I Item 1 heading is the second 'ITEM 1. FINANCIAL STATEMENTS' line. Part I Item 2 is printed 'ITEM 2:' with a colon. The page header repeats the company name on every page, not an Item heading, so the filing is not tagged running-headers. The safe harbor statement at the end of Part I stays in Part I Item 2. Part II has only Item 6; a line in Item 6 that starts 'Item 5, Other Events,' is a wrapped reference to an 8-K, not a heading. Part II Items 1 to 5 have no heading and are absent. Hard call: Part I Item 3 (market risk) has no heading and is listed absent. The form defined it from 1997, although a registrant of this size probably had to give quarterly market risk disclosure only from 1999; the absent list records what the form defines when the filing is made, as the fresh2 CCA Industries 2006 label does, while the fresh2 American Filtrona 1997 label leaves Item 3 out because its quarter ended before the Item took effect for anyone. Part I Item 4 and Part II Item 1A did not exist yet. Part II Item 6 ends at SIGNATURES, the filing end.
